messages.subject: single visit, multiple years
parts:
Hi Unmarked Users,

I've got a been of a quandary I'm trying to develop a work-around for. I have data for approximately 200 sites, across 5 years.  Each site was only visited once per year. This data is presence-absence data for a freshwater fish which occupies a large river system. In short, I broke rivers into distinct segments and then planned on using sites as spatial replicates within a given segment. This approach has precedence ( Dextrase et al. 2014; using PRESENCE and a spatial dependence model). While this approach would account for the spatial dependence assumption among sites within a segment, there remains the problem of each site being visited only once per year. My solution is to include a site covariate (Year) in the model to deal with any inherent bias associated with detection. Does this approach sound approach?

Regards,


Josh
